notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR13: data-name-10 holds the status of the previously executed RECEIVE, ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT, ENABLE INPUT or DISABLE INPUT, per Table 1. Every statement goes through MessageControlSession.Statement, which writes its Table 1 value at positions 80-81 (SetStatus). Probe gr13 at --std 85: RECEIVE 00, 20 (unknown queue and unknown sub-queue); ACCEPT 00 and 20; DISABLE INPUT 40 (wrong KEY), 00, 15 (again); ENABLE INPUT 00, 15, 20; ENABLE INPUT TERMINAL 21; DISABLE INPUT TERMINAL 00; a RECEIVE after DISABLE INPUT still gets data, as §1985:XIV.3.2.4 GR1 leaves the program-MCS path. The witness checks the status after RECEIVE.
